text.p: Industrial Property Management Ltd, the managers of Industrial Property Trust of Australia, said on Wednesday the trust would make a one-for-two rights issue to raise A$44.7 million.
The manager said the funds would be used to finance the acquisition of 10 industrial properties in the South East Melbourne regions of Dandenong and Hallam for A$28.6 million.

"Funds will also be applied towards the retirement of borrowings and the funding of two new industrial buildings as a part of stage three of the Discovery Cove Estate in Botany, New South Wales," the manager said in a statement.
The issue, at 90 cents per new unit, will be fully underwritten by Macquarie Underwriting Ltd and Ord Minnett Corporate Finance Ltd.
The manager said following the completion of the issue, the trust's borrowings would fall to 24 percent of total assets from 36 percent.
After the acquisitions the trust would own twenty properties and have total assets of about A$178 million, the manager said.
Industrial Property Trust of Australia units closed two cents weaker at 94 cents.
